qa_pairs.question: What specific environment variable must be manually set when running Fluent with Intel MPI on the Nibi cluster within an OnDemand Compute Desktop session to prevent crashes?
qa_pairs.answer: When running Fluent with Intel MPI on the Nibi cluster within an OnDemand Compute Desktop session, the environment variable `I_MPI_HYDRA_BOOTSTRAP=ssh` must be manually set to prevent crashes.

qa_pairs.question: What kind of error messages indicate that Fluent has crashed on the Nibi cluster because the `I_MPI_HYDRA_BOOTSTRAP=ssh` environment variable was not set?
qa_pairs.answer: If Fluent crashes on the Nibi cluster because `I_MPI_HYDRA_BOOTSTRAP=ssh` was not manually set, error output will appear, including messages such as "Error: Unable to run bstrap_proxy on g4.nibi.sharcnet (pid 2251587, exit code 256)" and "Error setting up the bootstrap proxies".
